content.title: Estate Cabernet
content.subtitle: Santa Cruz Mountains, 2021
content.intro: Cabernet from Ridge’s Monte Bello vineyard, from the blocks that make a more approachable wine than Monte Bello itself. A pure, mountain Cabernet that matures a little earlier.
content.taste_note: A guide, not a measurement of this bottle.
content.window_note: In its window now. Best 2025 to 2038.
content.decant: An hour if you open it now.
content.vintage: A dry winter, with 30% of normal rain, cut the crop. An early-September heat wave sped up the harvest, which ended September 24.
place: Monte Bello, from 1,300 to 2,670 feet up. The oldest vines here were planted in 1949.
Greenstone and clay over fractured limestone. The vines are not watered once they are established.
It was sold as Santa Cruz Mountains from 1978, and took the Estate name with the 2008 vintage.
content.credits: Text: Ridge Vineyards (2021 tech sheet). Serving advice is general guidance.
content.serve: 60 to 65°F. A little cooler than the room.
